eval.description: OpenAI internal cyber policy-compliance eval on production (or deidentified production) chat traffic and synthetic or semi-synthetic agentic environments. Covers benign, dual-use, and disallowed cyber requests, including MITRE ATT&CK-grounded scenarios. Scored as not_unsafe / policy compliance / safe completion / average safety score (higher is better). Dataset and runner are lab-internal. Cards rename the suite over time; categories stay the same eval.
eval.summary: Tests whether the model follows cyber policy by helping with safe requests and refusing harmful ones.

versions.changes: First tabled as Cyber safety evaluations in the GPT-5.2 system card (Production traffic / Synthetic data). Later cards rename the suite (Cyber model safety training, Cyber Model Refusal Evaluation, Cybersecurity Safety Evaluation) and add Semi-Synthetic Agentic Envs; policies and splits evolve.

scores.description: The response (and actions) comply with OpenAI cyber safety policy for that case (also reported as policy compliance or safe completion).

metrics.description: Share of cyber safety cases scored not_unsafe (also reported as policy compliance, safe completion, or average safety score). Higher is better. Per split (production vs synthetic / agentic).
